segments.name: ONS-5010/LYTENAVA
segments.description: Develops an ophthalmic formulation of bevacizumab.
segments.evidence: ​ Segment reporting We operate in a single reportable segment focused on the development and commercialization of ONS-5010/LYTENAVA™, an ophthalmic formulation of bevacizumab for treating wet AMD.

revenueModel.text: Clinics and patients' insurers pay for its treatment.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Chief Executive Officer serves as the chief operating decision maker, or CODM, and manages our operations on a consolidated basis.
